title: Project progress
description: One file per project (e.g. <project folder>/progress.json), written by the project owner's tooling and read by agent-dashboard. Only source facts are stored: the ordered stages, each grouping its ordered steps, and the schedule entries. Everything derivable — step and stage status, start/end, round counts, current step, completion ratio — is computed by the reader and must not be written here.

project.description: Project name as the project folder is named; the project's identity.

template.description: Name of the rule template the project was created from, if any.

stages.description: Workflow stages in order; each groups one or more steps. Stage order is array order.

steps.description: Steps of this stage in order. A step with no schedule entry has not started.

no.description: 1-based position across the whole workflow (matches the step folder number); unique.

schedules.description: Schedule entries (one per schedule note). Repeated entries for one step are its rounds; order is not significant.

path.description: Schedule note path relative to the project folder; unique.

step.description: The `no` of the step this entry belongs to.

date.description: Start date, or the day of a one-day event.

endDate.description: End date of a period entry; while active, the latest day worked. Omitted for one-day events.
